translated_title: National Electricity Coverage Will Reach 99.99% in 2028; It Is an Action of Energy Justice: Sheinbaum
original_title: Cobertura eléctrica nacional alcanzará el 99.99% en 2028; es una acción de justicia energética: Sheinbaum
author: Arturo Sánchez and Alma E. Muñoz
meta_description: A 21.4-billion-peso plan with 45,182 works will prioritize the Seri people, the Sierra Tarahumara, and other Indigenous and remote communities still off the grid.
